opening.argument: The strongest evidence is the format itself: the title identifies an interview with Taapsee Pannu, and the visible frame shows two people seated together under The Slow Interview branding. The conversation covers her journey, film work, family, friends, and social issues. Even when the interviewer turns to entrepreneurship, the money discussed is her own: she says she would put money into a business and describes buying a team. Those remarks present career history, not a request for viewers to invest, provide credentials, or join the venture. The request to like, comment, and share is ordinary engagement, with no financial benefit attached. Nothing in the cited material establishes an audience-directed offer or a financial outcome.
